thread:
anya: heads-up — noticed a batch of customer tickets from last night showing ~2x token usage after stream reconnects that also triggered tool calls. digging in.
sam: ugh, that sounds like the reconcilation hole we've worried about. any logs/trace IDs?
anya: example request id: req_gh7f. high-level sequence below — copied from logs / ledger dump.
anya: ```
# simplified events (timestamps omitted)
1) stream.open req=req_gh7f
2) stream.chunk tokens=120 provisional_entry(id=pe1)
3) toolcall.start req=req_gh7f tool=code-runner tc_id=tc42
4) client timeout -> toolcall.truncate tokens_charged=40 provisional_entry(id=pe2)
5) stream.close (network)
6) client reconnect -> stream.open req=req_gh7f (same id) -> stream.resume
7) toolcall.retry (same tc_id?) -> toolcall.start req=req_gh7f tool=code-runner tc_id=tc42
8) final stream.close -> server emits finalize(req=req_gh7f)
# ledger processing: provisional entries pe1 and pe2 were both promoted -> double charged for the toolcall tokens
```
lia: do we have an invariant that provisional entries with same (req, toolcall id) should dedupe? looks like our current promotion logic only considers chunk byte ranges, not toolcall pairing.
mike: current billing ledger treats provisional entries as independent rows. promotion scans provisional rows by request_id and accumulates. if same toolcall got two provisional rows (truncate + retry) both got promoted.
sam: root cause feels like: we don't emit a stable toolcall identifier reliably client->server across reconnects during streaming. sometimes the client reissues a new tc_id which gets treated as a separate charge, and sometimes it reuses the same id and we still double-count because the truncate produced a provisional settled entry.
anya: proposal A (short): enforce server-assigned immutable toolcall_instance_id at first toolcall.start and require stream resumes to replay that id. ledger promotion dedupes on (req_id, toolcall_instance_id).
sam: feasible, but client changes are risky for older SDKs. any backward-compatible approach?
anya: proposal B (compat): keep existing client behavior but attach a `session_token` to the stream that the server uses to coalesce provisional entries. when a reconnect resumes with same session_token, server merges provisional rows before promotion. no SDK change for tool calls (session_token already implicit in streaming session handshake for modern clients).
mike: merging before promotion is safer. but we need clear heuristics: merge only if timestamps within X minutes, same tool name, and chunk offsets don't overlap weirdly.
lia: from product/console POV we also need clearer visibility: show "Provisional credits" in billing console per-request and a separate column "Reconciled delta" after finalize. Users are confused by spikes that later drop.
anya: agree. UI mock: show provisional (light orange) and final (blue) with reconcile lag metric. hover explains promotion rules.
anya: metric ideas: billing.provisional_ratio, billing.reconciled_lag_seconds, billing.duplicate_promotions_count
sam: telemetry: add tag request.session_token, toolcall.name, toolcall.instance_id (if present) to all provisional events. then reconciliation job can use these to dedupe.
mike: on the ledger side we need an idempotency key for promotion: promote_key = sha256(req_id + session_token + toolcall_name + floor(chunk_start/64)). that will keep granularity and avoid merging unrelated chunks.
anya: one tricky case: partial truncation where the user legitimately retried the toolcall with changed args -> we must not merge. need to compare toolcall.signature (hash of args + image+version). if signature differs, treat as new.
sam: sounds good. implementable in runtime: compute signature at toolcall.start and store in provisional row.
lia: timeline / impact: customers using older SDKs may still see duplicates for a short window. we should add a dashboard widget that surfaces top requests by reconcile delta and a temporary automatic refund pipeline run for > $X anomalies.
mike: agreed. billing ops to own refunds; implement reconciliation 0.1 in 2 weeks.
anya: action items:
- sam: add session_token to stream resume events + store toolcall.signature on provisional rows (runtime change) — PR by EOW
- sam: telemetry tag changes + event for finalize (if missing) — PR by next Tue
- mike: schema change for ledger promotion idempotency and reconciliation job — start sprint planning
- lia: console mock for provisional/final columns and top-anomaly widget — draft by Fri
- reconcile-bot: create a one-off report weekly for the next month showing reconciled_lag and dup_promotions
reconcile-bot: scheduled report created: billing_reconciles_weekly (first run in 7d) :receipt: 
anya: FYI I'll patch a quick debug endpoint to replay req_gh7f and show provisional rows. ping me if you want to triage live with me.
sam: thanks. if we adopt session_token merge logic we should also document migration notes for SDKs (best-effort to reuse session token on resume).
lia: +1 — will add docs blurb and a console tooltip about expected reconcile windows (e.g., "final charges may differ for up to 5 minutes after stream close").
mike: ok — i'll coordinate refunds and safe-thresholds. also let's add an alert: Billing > reconciled_lag_seconds > 300 && duplicate_promotions_count > 5 -> #oncall-billing
anya: thanks everyone. keeping thread open for test results and PR links.
sam: noted, will post PRs here.
mike: will post ops-runbook and temporary refund rules.
lia: closing loop after console mock + docs.
